# Aggo - Reflection-free R2DBC DSL

Aggo is a type-safe, reflection-free R2DBC DSL for PostgreSQL, optimized for Kotlin and GraalVM native-image.

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Overview and basic usage.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Architecture map and core engineering standards.
- [docs/](docs/): Full documentation suite.

## Engineering Skills (Contextual Guidelines)
The following skills define the architectural laws and workflows of the project:

- [Architecture](.claude/skills/aggo-architecture.md): Zero-reflection law and package boundaries.
- [Workflow](.claude/skills/aggo-workflow.md): Branch naming, issue tracking, and commit conventions.
- [Codecs](.claude/skills/aggo-codec.md): How to implement and test data type bridges.
- [SQL Dialects](.claude/skills/aggo-dialect.md): Implementing DML and DDL for different backends.
- [Migrations](.claude/skills/aggo-migration.md): Schema versioning and DDL generation.
- [Query DSL](.claude/skills/aggo-query-dsl.md): Writing type-safe Select, Insert, Update, and Delete queries.
- [Predicates](.claude/skills/aggo-predicate-operator.md): Adding new WHERE operators and AST nodes.
- [Schema & Tables](.claude/skills/aggo-schema-table.md): Defining metadata descriptors.

## Technical Stack
- Kotlin
- R2DBC / PostgreSQL
- GraalVM Native Image
- Testcontainers
